case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Gardener Interview Name Caption
tests: Checks an exact two-line lower third that stays readable and correctly placed over a moving subject.

faults.what: The clip contains audible speech, transcribed as “Ona się śmieje.”, despite the explicit request for silence.
The lower third is already fully visible at 0.9 seconds, before the requested opening second has elapsed.

judge.summary: The clip shows the requested smiling garden portrait with clear, correctly spelled titles, but unwanted speech breaks the silence requirement and the title appears slightly early.

must_haves.item: A woman is visibly in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera.
must_haves.why: The woman smiles among raised garden beds and turns from a side profile toward the camera across the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', with no additional text.
must_haves.why: Both requested lines appear correctly spelled in the proper order, with no other visible text.

must_haves.item: Both lines use legible white lettering on a dark backing at the bottom left, with no clipping.
must_haves.why: Both lines are clearly readable in white on a dark translucent backing at the bottom left and are fully within the frame.

must_haves.item: The lower third does not cover her face and remains stable and readable as she moves.
must_haves.why: The title remains consistently positioned below her face and readable throughout the sampled movement.

must_haves.item: The caption is absent during the opening second and present from approximately second 1 through the end.
must_haves.why: It is already present at 0.9 seconds, contradicting its required absence during the opening second; it remains visible in all later samples.

must_haves.item: The delivered clip is silent, 16:9 and approximately 7 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are widescreen and the reported duration is approximately 7 seconds, but the supplied audio report identifies audible speech.
